proposals.evidence: The primary Hindi vegetable table, visually checked at PDF page 11 item 4, gives फूलगोबी “cauliflower”. Platts p. 858 independently lists phūl-kobī. The survey forms preserve the entire flower-plus-cabbage compound, with pʰ/f/ɸ and g/k or b/p regional adaptations; their precise Indo-Aryan transmission remains provisional. Existing Hindi pʰūlgobī “cauliflower” is the provisional donor, under the user’s preference to link supported cross-IA families. An intermediate Indo-Aryan language or another lending locality remains possible; the attestation locality is not claimed as the historical lending site.
